claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with current MMV/PSV/AutoFlow settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain SpO2 above the 88% desaturation limit, given hypoxemic respiratory failure on FiO2 40%.
Maintain arterial line and ICP monitoring with zeroing/calibration and continue neuro checks (GCS, pupillary exam), keeping ICP below 20 mmHg and CPP above 60 mmHg.
Replete potassium given serum K 3.4 mEq/L, with repeat potassium measurement after replacement.
Monitor and treat ionized hypocalcemia (1.06 mmol/L) with calcium repletion and repeat ionized calcium level.

Continue blood pressure support/titration of antihypertensive and vasoactive drips (nicardipine, labetalol, metoprolol, hydralazine as ordered) to keep MAP within the ordered arterial pressure alarm limits (low 80 mmHg).
Continue sedation per target RASS 0 with daily sedation interruption/lightening assessment, given current RASS -2 to -4.
Obtain daily morning labs including CBC, BMP, magnesium, phosphate, and coagulation studies to track WBC 14.8 K/uL and electrolytes.
Perform ventilator-associated pneumonia prevention bundle: subglottic suctioning, oral care, head-of-bed elevation, and cuff pressure monitoring (cuff 27 cmH2O).
Implement pressure injury prevention per Braden score (very limited sensory perception, bedfast, probably inadequate nutrition): repositioning schedule, specialty bed/surface, and nutrition consult.
Perform fall risk precautions given history of falls within 3 months and bed rest status: bed low, call light, assist with transfers.
